expectations.note: R2/R7 a table row index is a presentation selection; declaring it the data identity is refused.
R2 a tree node is not the identity of the relation, and hidden edges forbid a unique target.
R3 the rendered point is a tenant-month aggregate of invoice rows, so the inverse claim is refused.
R4 a spatial representation without a declared CRS is unqualified; two floats are not a geographic placement.
R5 equal rendered formula bytes are declared to establish equal computation, which is refused.
R6 domain time reported as playback time; the sync error bound is also absent. The contradiction is the stronger reading, so the verdict is rejected rather than unqualified.
The table carries a line occurrence with its own identity, the grain matches the source grain, and every required column is declared.
R1 a meaning-bearing instance outside any Function Data Context is refused. A palette preview may be independent, but this one shows a field of a selected order.
R9 the matrix layout is declared to be the data meaning; the layout stays a layout.
R8 two different contexts share the same scope; the scope is not reused across contexts.
A Gantt bar is a task interval on the domain axis, the clock and the error bound are declared, and the grain matches.
The page axis is declared generated, so it is not reported as a source axis; the structural role matches the source. A generated axis is informational, not a failure.
R4/R7 a composite panel showing an order total over line rows cannot qualify an inverse to the lines.
R6 the clock is unknown, so the synchronization claim is unqualified. An error bound of zero does not substitute for a clock.
